title: How long was Noah on the Ark?

beats.text: Noah was not on the Ark forty days.
beats.scene: Painted colossal ark at dusk in heavy rain with a crossed-out 40. Overlay: crossed-out 40.

beats.text: Forty days is only how long it rained.
beats.scene: Torrential rain over the ark and dark hills. Overlay: counter 40 days.

beats.text: Genesis 7:11 dates the flood: second month, seventeenth day.
beats.scene: Calendar-like stone tablet carved with day marks. Overlay: date badge month 2 day 17.

beats.text: The waters stayed on the earth one hundred fifty days.
beats.scene: Endless flat water under a pink sunset with the ark afloat. Overlay: counter 150 days.

beats.text: Then the ark rested, and the waters slowly fell.
beats.scene: Ark on a mountain ridge as water recedes. Overlay: none.

beats.text: Noah sent a raven, which flew back and forth.
beats.scene: Black raven flying off the ark at dawn. Overlay: counter 1.

beats.text: He sent a dove three times; the third did not return.
beats.scene: White dove carrying an olive leaf at sunrise. Overlay: counter 3.

beats.text: Genesis 8:14 says the earth was dry: second month, twenty-seventh day.
beats.scene: Cracked dry mud around the ark at morning. Overlay: date badge month 2 day 27.

beats.text: That is about a year and ten days inside.
beats.scene: Ark at sunrise, long shadow, camera drifting. Overlay: counter 1 year 10 days.

beats.text: Try staying home one weekend. Now do it for a year.
beats.scene: Person at a window looking out at rain. Overlay: counter 365 days.

beats.text: Not proven: scholars debate whether the flood was global or local.
beats.scene: Mountain ridge in mist at sunrise. Overlay: question mark badge.

beats.text: So not forty days. A year, or forty days?
beats.scene: Ark in the golden sunset sea, slow push. Overlay: choice tags A forty days / B a year.

youtube.title: How Long Was Noah on the Ark? #shorts
youtube.description:
Everyone says forty days. The text says about a year and ten days.
Whether the flood was global or local is debated; we only read the dates.
#NoahsArk #Genesis #Bible #BibleHistory
